title: operations.procurement.purchase_order.received
description: An approved purchase order was received into stock. `received_date` and `expected_date` are business dates; comparing them is what on-time delivery means. Lines whose SKU matched an inventory item were posted to the stock ledger (`matched_lines`); the rest are listed in `unmatched_skus`. Emitted when the last line is received, whether by the single-shot endpoint or by the final goods receipt (inventory Phase 2); `matched_lines` are the lines of that receipt.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I5): services/operations/app/services.py:receive_purchase_order does not emit expected_date yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.

quantity.description: Whole units of the cumulative quantity received on the line (floor); `quantity_exact` is the exact figure.
